rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=200, recon_eta=80.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=True, recon_dcstep_every=12, recon_dcstep_n_cg=20, recon_dcstep_warmup=0, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=20, train_n=0, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 (toward 20): recon_dcstep_warmup 5->0 at the iter-12 winning config (eta=80 / dcstep_every=12 / n_cg=20 / warmup=5). iter-12 was the FIRST real break above the soft-DC plateau: warmup 25->5 lifted SSIM 0.8670->0.8797 (+0.0127), the largest single-knob gain since the eta/dcstep climb. PUSH THE SAME WINNING LEVER: with recon_init=fbp the sample starts near-clean, so EVERY skipped early reverse-step is a WASTED DC projection that could anchor the FBP-init sample to the data manifold; warmup=0 engages data-consistency from the very first step (full ~12% earlier than warmup=25, ~2.5% earlier than warmup=5). UNCONSTRAINED DPS is structurally hr=0 (<LD-FBP ~0.94): the soft adaptive-weight gradient never enforces Ax=y, so closing the warmup gap is the last way to extend the 0.8797 gain toward the hard-DC ceiling. Hyp: warmup 5->0 either CONTINUES the gain (warmup was still suppressing usable early DC) or SATURATES at ~0.880 (the warmup lever bottoms out, documenting the soft-DC ceiling). Wall: iter-12 was 1088s; warmup 5->0 adds only 5 more early DC-steps at n_cg=20, a tiny increment, stays well under the 1h wall (keep sample_steps=200, val_n=20 as iter-12).
